y-m-56-09.topic: Nuna bayanai da aikin layi: zangon da samfurin layi za a iya amincewa da shi.
y-m-56-09.goal: Yi hasashen ƙimomin kusa ta amfani da layin da ya dace da bayanai, amma ka san cewa a zangon nesa ba tare da bayanai ba dole ne a daidaita matakin amincewa da hasashen a duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana, sannan ka bayyana hukuncin da kalmomi.
y-m-56-09.material:
Mun auna tsayin wata shuka ta ƙirƙira kowace rana (naúrar cm ce, ranar shuka kuma rana 0 ce).
Rana 0: 5.0, Rana 1: 6.1, Rana 2: 7.0, Rana 3: 8.2, Rana 4: 8.9
Da tunanin cewa shukar tana ƙaruwa kusan 1 cm a rana, mun nuna ta da layi y=5+x (x rana ce, y tsayi ne). Za a bayyana sababbin bayanai mataki-mataki nan gaba.

y-m-56-09.thinking.1: Tantance ko a ci gaba da amfani da samfurin ko a sanya masa iyaka.
y-m-56-09.thinking.2: Bayyana rashin tabbas na hasashe a wajen zangon bayanai.

y-m-56-08.title: Wane aji ne ya fi amfani da ɗakin karatun aji?
y-m-56-08.topic: Kwatanta bayanai: ƙirga da rabo, da bayanin da ake buƙata don kwatantawa.
y-m-56-08.goal: Gane cewa adadin ɗaliban da suka yi amfani ba ya isa kwatanta yawan amfani na kowane aji; nuna bayanin da ake buƙata (jimillar ɗalibai), sannan gina yanayin da ya dace da sharadi idan sabon bayani ya zo.
y-m-56-08.material: Watan da ya wuce, ɗalibai 12 a aji A da 9 a aji B sun yi amfani da ɗakin karatu na aji. Ba mu san jimillar ɗaliban kowane aji ba. A nan “ajin da ya fi amfani” na nufin “ajin da rabon ɗaliban da suka yi amfani da ɗakin karatu zuwa duk ɗalibai ya fi girma”. Ka tuna adadin ɗaliban aji na iya bambanta.

y-m-56-08.prereq.1: Tunanin asali na relative frequency (ƙirga÷jimillar ƙirga) (matakin sakandare ƙaramar).
y-m-56-08.s.s1.prompt: Da bayanin da muke da shi yanzu kaɗai, wane aji za mu iya cewa rabon amfani ya fi girma?
y-m-56-08.s.s1.hint.0: Zaɓi jimillar ɗalibai masu yiwuwa kaɗan ga aji biyun ka lissafa kowane rabo.
y-m-56-08.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko wanne aji ya fi rabo yana canzawa bisa jimillolin da ka zaɓa.
y-m-56-08.s.s1.o.a: Aji A (domin ɗalibai 12 sun yi amfani, ya fi yawa).
y-m-56-08.s.s1.r.a: Hukuncin ya ɗauki adadin masu amfani kai tsaye a matsayin girman rabo. Duba ko har yanzu haka yake idan jimilloli sun bambanta.
y-m-56-08.s.s1.o.b: Aji B (domin aji mai kaɗan masu amfani wataƙila jimillar ɗalibai ma kaɗan ce).
y-m-56-08.s.s1.r.b: An fassara ƙaramin adadin masu amfani a matsayin jimillar ɗalibai ma ƙarama. Sake karanta ko an bayar da jimillar ɗalibai.
y-m-56-08.s.s1.o.c: Ajujuwan sun bambanta da ɗalibai 3 kacal da suka yi amfani, saboda haka rabon kusan ɗaya ne.
y-m-56-08.s.s1.r.c: Hukunci ne da ya karanta bambancin ƙirga a matsayin bambancin rabo. Duba abin da ke faruwa idan girman ajujuwan ya bambanta.
y-m-56-08.s.s1.o.d: Idan ba mu san jimilloli ba, ba za mu iya cewa wanne aji ya fi ba.
y-m-56-08.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya ce rabo ɓangare ne idan aka kwatanta da duka, don haka ba za a kwatanta ba tare da sanin duka ba.
y-m-56-08.s.s1.explain: Rabo shi ne adadin ɗaliban da suka yi amfani da aka raba da jimillar ɗaliban aji. Idan ba a san jimilloli ba, ba za ka iya sanin ko masu amfani 12 suna da babban rabo ba. Misali, idan A tana da ɗalibai 60, 12/60=0.2; idan B tana da 20, 9/20=0.45, B ya fi. Idan A tana da 15, B kuma 30, A ya fi.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.prompt: Kana son yanke aji da ya fi yawan amfani. Zaɓi duk bayanan da za su ba ka damar kwatanta ta sanin wannan bayani guda ɗaya kawai, ba tare da wani ba. (Za a iya samun fiye da ɗaya.)
y-m-56-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ga bayanin kowane zaɓi, duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko yana ba ka jimillar ɗaliban aji.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.hint.1: Yi tunani ko akwai bayanin da ba a amfani da shi wajen nemo rabo ko da an san shi.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.r.a: Hukunci ne da ya ce wannan bayani ne kai tsaye ke ba da denominator na rabon.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.o.b: Jimillar littattafai a kan rumfunan ɗakin karatu na aji.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.r.b: Tabbatar cewa girman ɗakin karatu ba ya yanke rabon ɗaliban da suka yi amfani.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.o.c: Matsakaicin adadin lokutan da ɗaliban da suka yi amfani suka aro littafi.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.r.c: Yawan aro wani mizani ne dabam da “rabo na ɗaliban da suka yi amfani”.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.o.d: Adadin ɗaliban kowane aji da ba su yi amfani ba.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya ce idan aka ƙara shi da yawan ɗaliban da suka yi amfani da shi, za a samu jimilla; saboda haka ana iya sanin ƙididdigar ƙasa a kaikaice.
y-m-56-08.s.s2.explain: Domin nemo rabo, ana bukatar yawan ɗaliban ajin gaba ɗaya. Idan an san ɗaliban da ba su yi amfani da shi ba, za a iya ƙara masu amfani (12 da 9) a samu jimilla; saboda haka bayanin iri ɗaya ne a wata siga. Ba a amfani da jimillar littattafai ko matsakaicin yawan aro wajen kwatanta da wannan mizani.

y-m-56-08.s.s2.acc.1: Yawan ɗaliban da ba su yi amfani da shi kaɗai ya isa domin yana bayyana jimilla. Daidai yake da sanin yawan ɗalibai gaba ɗaya kai tsaye.

y-m-56-08.s.s3.fail.c1: Ɗalibai 12 ne suka yi amfani da shi, saboda haka jimilla dole ta zama lamba cikakkiya aƙalla 12.

y-m-56-03.title: Idan zangon x ya sauya, shin ƙaramin ƙima ma tana sauyawa?
y-m-56-03.topic: Mafi ƙarancin ƙimar aiki: yadda sakamakon ke sauyawa da yankin aiki (zangon x).
y-m-56-03.goal: Ka san cewa ko ma’auni iri ɗaya ne, ƙaramin ƙima na iya kasancewa iri ɗaya, ta sauya, ko ba ta wanzu bisa zangon x (yankin aiki); samar da tazarori da suka cika sharadi.
y-m-56-03.material: Ka yi la’akari da f(x)=x²−4x+5. (Ana karanta x² da “x murabba’i”.) Wasu ƙimomi su ne f(0)=5, f(1)=2, f(2)=1, f(3)=2, f(4)=5. Idan ba a bayar da zangon x ba, x na iya zama kowace lamba ta gaske. Mu sauya zangon x mu duba abin da ya faru da mafi ƙarancin ƙimar f.

y-m-56-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ana iya rubuta f(x) a matsayin (x−2)²+1, saboda haka 1 idan x=2 ita ce mafi ƙanƙanta. Idan x=1.5 ne, ƙimar 1.25 ce; idan x=2.5 ma 1.25 ce; duka sun fi 1.

y-m-56-02.title: A ina ne ma’aunin jadawalin da aka matsar ya yi kuskure?
y-m-56-02.topic: Matsar da jadawali: tabbatar da ma’aunin jadawalin da aka matsar.
y-m-56-02.goal: Lokacin rubuta ma’auni bayan an matsar da jadawali, kada ka dogara da ƙa’idar alkibla da alama da ka haddace kawai. Tabbatar da ma’aunin ta amfani da maki da jadawalin da aka matsar dole ya wuce ta, sannan ka gane cewa matsarwa da dama na iya cika sharadi ɗaya.
y-m-56-02.material: Jadawalin aikin y=|x| sifar “V” ce mai kolo a (0, 0); y=1 ne idan x=1 ko x=−1. (Ana karanta |x| da “cikakkiyar ƙimar x”.) Minjae ya rubuta mafita don nemo ma’aunin jadawalin da aka samu ta matsar da wannan jadawali dama da 2 (a alkiblar tabbatacciya ta axis x).
y-m-56-02.thinking.0: Duba daidaiton kowane layi da layin da ya gabace shi.
y-m-56-02.thinking.1: Tabbatar da ma’auni ta amfani da maki da ka riga ka sani.
y-m-56-02.thinking.2: Gano cewa matsarwa fiye da ɗaya na iya cika sharadi.

y-m-56-02.s.s1.hint.0: Saka maki (2, 0) da aka samo a layi na 2 kai tsaye cikin ma’auni a layi na 3.
y-m-56-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta kowane layi da wanda ya gabace shi ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
y-m-56-02.s.s1.line.0: Ma’aunin asalin jadawali y=|x| ne, kuma kolo (0, 0) ne.
y-m-56-02.s.s1.line.1: Idan aka matsar da shi dama da 2, kolo yana zuwa (2, 0).
y-m-56-02.s.s1.line.2: An matsar da shi +2 a alkiblar x, saboda haka a maye gurbin x cikin ma’auni da x+2, a rubuta y=|x+2|.
y-m-56-02.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka ma’aunin jadawalin da aka matsar shi ne y=|x+2|.
y-m-56-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne na farko da bai dace ba. Layi na 2 ya ce kolo ya zama (2, 0), amma idan aka saka x=2 cikin ma’aunin y=|x+2| a layi na 3, ana samun y=4, saboda haka bai wuce ta (2, 0) ba. Layi na 4 ya ɗauko ma’aunin layi na 3 yadda yake, saboda haka shi ma ba daidai ba ne.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.prompt: Wace hanya ce mafi kai tsaye ta tabbatar da cewa ƙarshen Minjae kuskure ne?
y-m-56-02.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta maki da ka riga ka sani cewa jadawalin da aka matsar dole ya wuce ta cikinsu.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.hint.1: Saka koòrdinatin wannan maki a ma’aunin, sannan ka duba ko daidaito ya tabbata.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.o.a: Saka kolo da aka matsar (2, 0) cikin sabon ma’auni y=|x+2|.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.r.a: Ka gwada ko maki da jadawalin da aka matsar dole ya wuce ta yana cika sabon ma’aunin.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.o.b: Saka x=0 cikin sabon ma’auni y=|x+2| ka duba ko y=2.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.r.b: Ka duba lissafin cikin sabon ma’aunin kawai. Ba ka kwatanta da maki da ka riga ka sani a jadawalin da aka matsar ba.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.o.c: Saka x=2 cikin asalin ma’auni y=|x| ka duba ko y=2.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.r.c: Ka gwada ma’aunin kafin matsarwa. Wannan lissafi ba zai gaya ko ma’aunin bayan matsarwa ya dace da jadawalin da aka matsar ba.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.o.d: Karɓi “an matsar da shi +2, saboda haka a rubuta +2 a ma’auni ma” a matsayin daidai, ka wuce.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.r.d: Ka amince da ƙa’idar cewa alamar alkiblar matsawa da ta ma’auni iri ɗaya ce. Dole a gwada ƙa’idar da maki domin sanin ko daidai ce.
y-m-56-02.s.s2.explain: Idan ka saka maki (2, 0), wanda jadawalin da aka matsar dole ya wuce ta, cikin sabon ma’auni, kana samun y=4; hakan yana nuna kuskure. Tsohon ma’auni (a) ko lissafin cikin sabon ma’auni (b) ba za su nuna ko “ya dace da jadawalin da aka matsar” ba.
y-m-56-02.s.s3.prompt: A wannan karon, daga ma’aunai masu sigar y=|x−h|+1, samar da waɗanda jadawalinsu ke wucewa ta maki (0, 4). Nemo ƙimomin h biyu daban-daban. (Ana karanta |x−h| da “cikakkiyar ƙimar x cire h”.)
y-m-56-02.s.s3.hint.0: Saka x=0, y=4 cikin ma’aunin sannan ka samar da ma’auni mai h.
y-m-56-02.s.s3.hint.1: Gwada ƙimar h tabbatacciya da mara kyau ka duba ko y zai zama 4.
y-m-56-02.s.s3.ok.c1: Idan x=0, y=4, saboda haka yana wucewa ta maki (0, 4).
y-m-56-02.s.s3.fail.c1: Idan aka saka x=0, y ba ya zama 4. Saka x=0 a ma’aunin ka gwada ƙimar h.
y-m-56-02.s.s3.explain: Saka x=0, y=4 yana ba da |h|+1=4, wato |h|=3; saboda haka h=3 ko h=−3. Idan h=3 ne, an matsar da jadawalin dama da 3; idan h=−3 ne, an matsar da shi hagu da 3; duka kuma an ɗaga shi sama da 1.

y-m-56-01.title: Shin za a iya kiran wannan alaƙa aiki?
y-m-56-01.topic: Ma’anar aiki: alaƙa inda kowane shigarwa ke ba da sakamako guda ɗaya tak.
y-m-56-01.goal: Gwada kowace alaƙa da sharadin ma’anar cewa kowane shigarwa yana ba da sakamako guda ɗaya tak; tantance waɗanda ayyuka ne, gyara alaƙar da ba aiki ba domin ta zama aiki, sannan ka gina aiki mai sharadin zango.
y-m-56-01.material:
A aji mai ɗalibai 28, kowane ɗalibi yana da lambar halarta guda daga 1 zuwa 28, kuma kowane ɗalibi yana da ranar haihuwa guda ɗaya (a yi watsi da shekarar tsalle). Ana kiran alaƙar da kowane shigarwa ke ba da sakamako guda ɗaya “aiki”. A nan sakamako yana nufin lamba guda (ko lambar halarta guda); ba a ƙirga tarin sakamako da yawa a matsayin sakamako ɗaya ba. Ga alaƙa huɗu: 
(가) lambar halarta → watan da aka haifi ɗalibin (Janairu zuwa Disamba)
(나) watan haihuwa (Janairu zuwa Disamba) → lambobin halartar ɗaliban da aka haifa a watan
(다) lambar halitta → yawan masu raba wannan lambar
(라) lambar halitta → lambobin da suke masu rabanta

y-m-56-01.thinking.1: Yi bayani da takamaiman lambobi dalilin da ya sa alaƙa ba aiki ba ce.
y-m-56-01.thinking.2: Gina ayyuka daban-daban da suka cika sharadin zangon.

y-m-56-01.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya ce kowane shigarwa (lambar halarta) yana ba da watan haihuwa guda ɗaya tak. Ka duba sharadin ma’anar.
y-m-56-01.s.s1.r.b: Idan ka yanke cewa “akwai ɗalibai saboda haka lambar tana tabbata”, duba ko akwai watan da ɗalibai da yawa aka haifa a ciki ko babu ɗalibi ko ɗaya.

y-m-56-01.s.s1.explain: A (가), kowane ɗalibi yana da ranar haihuwa guda ɗaya, saboda haka ana kayyade watan haihuwa a matsayin guda ɗaya. A (다), kowace lamba tana da yawan masu rabanta guda ɗaya tak. A (나), ɗalibai 28 an haife su a cikin watanni 12, saboda haka dole ne a sami wata guda da aka haifi ɗalibai biyu ko fiye a ciki, kuma ba a kayyade lamba guda ɗaya ba (wataƙila akwai watan da babu ɗalibi ma). A (라), wasu lambobi kamar 6 suna da masu raba da yawa, saboda haka sakamakon ba guda ɗaya ba ne.
y-m-56-01.s.s2.prompt: Ana kiran tarin duk ƙimomin da aiki zai iya bayarwa “zango”. Ga aiki f mai yankin aiki {1, 2, 3}, kayyade f(1), f(2), f(3) sannan ka samar da ayyuka daban-daban uku waɗanda zangonsu daidai yake da {4, 5}. (Ana karanta f(1) da “f na 1”, f(2) “f na 2”, f(3) “f na 3”.)

y-m-56-01.s.s2.hint.1: Gwada sa ƙimomin ukun duka iri ɗaya, sannan ka duba abin da zangon zai zama.
y-m-56-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Wani shigarwa yana da ƙimar f wadda ba 4 ko 5 ba ce. Zango dole ya zama {4, 5}.
y-m-56-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Duka 4 da 5 sun bayyana a cikin ƙimomi.
y-m-56-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ɗaya daga 4 da 5 bai bayyana ba. Domin zangon ya zama dukkan {4, 5}, dole lambobin biyun su bayyana.
y-m-56-01.s.s2.explain: Dole a ba kowane shigarwa ƙima guda, 4 da 5 kuma su bayyana aƙalla sau ɗaya. Daga nau’i-nau’i 2×2×2=8 da za su yiwu, cire shari’o’i 2 inda duk ƙimomi 4 ne ko duk 5 ne; sai a rage 6.

y-m-56-04.title: A ina maki C ya kamata ya kasance domin a samar da alwatika mai ƙafafu biyu daidai?
y-m-56-04.topic: Tazara tsakanin maki biyu a faifan koòrdinati da alwatika mai ƙafafu biyu daidai.
y-m-56-04.goal: Kwatanta tazarorin maki biyu ta amfani da koòrdinati, samar da maki da ke ba da alwatika mai ƙafafu biyu daidai ta hanyoyi daban-daban, sannan ka ware shari’ar da ba alwatika ba ce (duk maki a layi guda).
y-m-56-04.material: A faifan koòrdinati akwai A(0, 0) da B(4, 0). Kana son zaɓar maki C(x, y) wanda koòrdinatin x da y duka lambobi cikakku ne, domin gina alwatika ABC. Murabba’in tazarar maki biyu shi ne bambancin kwance murabba’i da bambancin tsaye murabba’i a haɗe. Don haka AB²=16, AC²=x²+y², BC²=(x−4)²+y². (Kwatanta murabba’in tsawon yana ba da sakamako iri ɗaya da kwatanta tsawon ba tare da tushen murabba’i ba.)
y-m-56-04.thinking.0: Mayar da sharadin alwatika mai ƙafafu biyu daidai zuwa kwatanta tazara.
y-m-56-04.thinking.1: Samar da mafita da yawa daban-daban a cikin ƙuntatawa.
y-m-56-04.thinking.2: Nemo shari’ar lalacewa (wadda ba alwatika ba ce).
y-m-56-04.prereq.0: Ka’idar Pythagoras (matakin sakandare): tsawon hypotenuse na alwatika mai kusurwar dama inda ƙafafun biyu bambancin kwance da bambancin tsaye ne.
y-m-56-04.prereq.1: Karanta koòrdinatin maki a faifan koòrdinati da ma’anar alwatika mai ƙafafu biyu daidai.
y-m-56-04.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk shari’o’in da alwatika ABC yake da ƙafafu biyu daidai.
y-m-56-04.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta duk hanyoyin haɗa gefuna biyu daga ukun (AB, AC, BC), waɗanda sunayensu daban-daban ne.
y-m-56-04.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta ma’anar “alwatika mai ƙafafu biyu daidai” da kalmomi, sannan ka duba ko dole gefuna ukun su yi daidai.

y-m-56-04.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya ce shari’ar da gefe AB ya yi daidai da AC ma alwatika ce mai ƙafafu biyu daidai.
y-m-56-04.s.s1.o.b: Dole gefuna ukun su yi tsawo iri ɗaya.

y-m-56-04.s.s1.r.c: Wannan hukunci ya ce shari’ar da gefuna biyu ban da AB suka yi daidai ma alwatika mai ƙafafu biyu daidai ce.
y-m-56-04.s.s1.o.d: AB da BC suna da tsawo iri ɗaya.
y-m-56-04.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya ce gefen da aka kira AB ma zai iya zama ɗaya daga gefuna masu daidaito.
y-m-56-04.s.s1.explain: Alwatika mai ƙafafu biyu daidai tana bukatar gefuna biyu daga cikin ukun su yi tsawo iri ɗaya kawai. Ba dole duk ukun su yi daidai ba (wannan alwatika mai gefuna uku daidai ce). Saboda haka AB=AC, AC=BC da AB=BC duka shari’o’in alwatika mai ƙafafu biyu daidai ne.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi maki C(x, y) inda x da y duka lambobi cikakku ne, y≠0 (domin dole ya zama alwatika), |x|≤10, |y|≤10, ta yadda alwatika ABC mai ƙafafu biyu daidai zai samu. Nemo maki C guda huɗu daban-daban.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta AB², AC², BC² da x da y, sannan ka yi tunanin ɗaya bayan ɗaya waɗanne biyu za su iya zama daidai.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi maki guda, lissafta murabba’in tsawon gefuna ukun, sannan ka duba ko akwai biyun da suka yi daidai.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Lambobi cikakku ne, y ba 0 ba ne, kuma suna cikin zangon.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.fail.c1: x da y dole su zama lambobi cikakku daga −10 zuwa 10, y kuma ba 0 ba ne.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Gefuna biyu suna da tsawo iri ɗaya, saboda haka alwatika ce mai ƙafafu biyu daidai.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Babu gefuna biyu masu tsawo iri ɗaya daga AB, AC, BC. Lissafta murabba’in tsawon gefuna ukun ka kwatanta.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.explain: Maki mai x=2 (misali (2, 1), (2, −3)) yana da AC=BC. Ga (0, 4) da (0, −4), AC²=16=AB²; ga (4, 4) da (4, −4), BC²=16=AB². Idan y=0, A, B, C suna kan layi guda, saboda haka ba alwatika ba ce.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Rukunta maki da ka samar da makamantansu, sannan ga kowane rukuni ka rubuta waɗanne gefuna biyu suke da tsawo iri ɗaya. Ka kuma bayyana dalilin barin maki y=0.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Rubuta koòrdinatin x na makinka gefe da gefe.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bayyana da kalmomi ba tare da hoto ba inda A, B, C suke idan y=0.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana nau’o’i nawa makinka suka kasu?
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ga kowane nau’i, ka tabbatar da ma’auni ko lambobi waɗanne gefuna biyu suka yi daidai?
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana ta matsayin maki dalilin da ya sa ba alwatika ba ce idan y=0?
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Maki mai x=2 yana da tazara iri ɗaya daga A da B, saboda haka AC=BC. (0,4) ko (4,4) suna da tazara 4, daidai da tsawon AB, saboda haka AB=AC ko AB=BC. Idan y=0, maki ukun suna kan layi madaidaiciya, don haka ba alwatika ba ce; saboda haka na bar su.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan koòrdinatin x na C=2 ne, yana sama da tsakiyar A da B, saboda haka AC da BC daidai ne; idan kuma maki ne mai tazara 4 daga asali ko daga B, ya yi daidai da AB. Idan y=0, A, B, C suna kan layi guda, saboda haka ba sa samar da alwatika.
y-m-56-04.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: An bayyana da kalmomi, amma rarraba zuwa nau’o’i a bayyane yake.

y-m-56-05.title: Nemo layin da ke haɗuwa a (1, 3) kaɗai.
y-m-56-05.topic: Matsayin layuka biyu: haɗuwa a maki guda kawai.
y-m-56-05.goal: Ka san cewa ba za a tantance ko layuka biyu sun haɗu ta gwajin wasu ƙimomi kaɗan kawai ba; bambance sharadin haɗuwa a maki guda (gangarori daban-daban) da yanayin layukan da suka yi daidai, sannan ka gina irin wannan layi da kanka.
y-m-56-05.material: Layi L shi ne y=2x+1. Maki (1, 3) yana kan layin (saka x=1 yana ba da y=3). Kana son zaɓar wani layi M mai sigar y=mx+n (m da n lambobi cikakku ne) da zai haɗu da L a (1, 3) kaɗai. Da farko duba wace hanya ce amintacciya wajen tantance ko layuka biyu sun haɗu, sannan ka gina M. Ka yi tunanin layi yana ci gaba ba ƙarewa a ɓangarorin biyu.
y-m-56-05.thinking.0: Kwatanta ingancin hanyoyi daban-daban na tantancewa.
y-m-56-05.thinking.1: Gina layuka da dama da suka cika sharudda (maki da ya wuce ta, gangara).
y-m-56-05.thinking.2: Ware shari’ar layukan da suka yi daidai ta amfani da misalin karyatawa.
y-m-56-05.prereq.0: Ma’anar gangara m a jadawalin aikin layi y=mx+n (matakin sakandare).
y-m-56-05.prereq.1: Saka koòrdinatin maki cikin ma’auni domin tabbatar ko layin yana wucewa ta wurin.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk hanyoyin da za su sa ka kammala cewa layi y=2x+1 da y=2x+5 “ba sa haɗuwa”.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.hint.0: Saka x iri ɗaya cikin ma’aunai biyu, sannan ga wasu ƙimomi na x ka rubuta yadda bambancin ƙimomin y ke kasancewa.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi la’akari da yiwuwar sakamakon ya bambanta a x ɗin da ba ka gwada ba, tare da gaskiyar cewa layi yana ci gaba ba ƙarewa.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.o.a: Kwatanta gangarorin ma’aunai biyu, ka tabbatar sun yi daidai amma yankewar axis y ta bambanta.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya yi amfani da gangara da yankewar axis y domin ganin ko layukan biyu suna nesa da juna.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.o.b: Saka x=1, 2, 3, 4, ka duba cewa ƙimomin y biyun ba su taɓa zama iri ɗaya ba.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.r.b: Ka gwada wasu x kaɗan kawai. Ka yi tunanin ko har yanzu akwai damar haɗuwa a x da ba ka gwada ba (adadi mai digo, babban lamba, da sauransu).
y-m-56-05.s.s1.o.c: Zana layukan biyu a takarda, idan ba su yi kama da suna haɗuwa ba, ka yanke cewa ba sa haɗuwa.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.r.c: Suna iya haɗuwa a wajen ɓangaren da ka zana. Duba ko ka yi la’akari da cewa layi yana ci gaba ba ƙarewa.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.o.d: Duba ko za a iya warware ma’aunin 2x+1=2x+5 da aka samar ta daidaita ma’aunai biyun.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya ce idan akwai maki haɗuwa, dole akwai x da ƙimar y na ma’aunai biyun suka yi daidai.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.explain: Idan gangarori iri ɗaya ne amma yankewar axis y ta bambanta, bambancin ƙimomin y biyun lamba tabbatacciya 4 ce a kowane x; saboda haka layukan ba sa haɗuwa. Ba za a iya warware ma’aunin da aka samu ta daidaita su da kowane x ba, kuma hakan yana ba da hukunci iri ɗaya. Gwada wasu x kaɗan ko zana wani ɓangare na layi kawai yana barin wuraren da ba a gwada ba; saboda haka ba ya tabbatar da “ba sa haɗuwa” (amma yana iya gano misalin karyatawa da ke nuna suna haɗuwa).
y-m-56-05.s.s2.prompt: Yanzu zaɓi layi M: y=mx+n (m da n cikakkun lambobi ne daga −9 zuwa 9) da zai haɗu da L (y=2x+1) a maki (1,3) kaɗai. Nemo (m,n) guda uku dabam-dabam. [lambobi: 9, 9, 2, 1, 1, 3]
y-m-56-05.s.s2.hint.0: Saka maki (1,3) cikin y=mx+n ka samu dangantaka tsakanin m da n. [lambobi: 1, 3]
y-m-56-05.s.s2.hint.1: Saka m=2 ka duba abin da zai faru da M da L.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.ok.c1: m da n cikakkun lambobi ne daga −9 zuwa 9.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.fail.c1: m da n dole su zama cikakkun lambobi daga −9 zuwa 9.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Idan aka saka x=1, y ba ya zama 3. Duba ko M yana ratsa (1,3). [lambobi: 1, 3, 1, 3]
y-m-56-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Gangarorin sun bambanta, saboda haka suna haɗuwa a maki guda (1,3). [lambobi: 1, 3]
y-m-56-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Idan gangara 2 ce, duk M da ke ratsa (1,3) ya rufe L gaba ɗaya; layukan ba sa haɗuwa a maki guda kawai. [lambobi: 2, 1, 3]
y-m-56-05.s.s2.explain: Domin ya ratsa (1,3), m+n=3. Amma idan m=2, n=1, saboda haka M ya zama layi ɗaya da L, kuma suna da haɗuwa marasa iyaka. Don haka biyun (m,n) da m≠2 ne kaɗai suke haɗuwa a maki guda tak. Misalai: (0,3),(1,2),(−1,4),(5,−2). [lambobi: 1, 3, 3, 2, 1, 2, 0, 3, 1, 2, 1, 4, 5, 2]
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa m=2 ba ya halatta, sannan ka yanke ko “layi M da ya ratsa (1,3) kullum yana haɗuwa da L a maki guda” gaskiya ne, tare da sharadi. [lambobi: 2, 1, 3]
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Saka m=2 cikin m+n=3 don nemo n, sannan ka kwatanta ma’aunin layin da L.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Yi tunani ko layuka biyu masu gangara dabam-dabam dole su haɗu a wani wuri.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka duba da ma’auni takamaimai abin da M yake zama idan m=2?
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka amsa “kullum gaskiya ne?” tare da sharadi (idan gangarorin sun bambanta)?
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ka yi tunani kuma ga yanayin gangarori ɗaya amma wuraren da suke ratsa sun bambanta (ba sa haɗuwa)?
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan m=2, gangara ɗaya ce, saboda haka layi mai ratsa (1,3) ya zama y=2x+1, ya rufe L. Suna haɗuwa a maki marasa iyaka, ba guda ba. Don haka gangara dole ta bambanta da 2 domin su haɗu a maki guda kawai.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Kowane layi ta (1,3) mai gangara dabam da ta L yana haɗuwa da ita a maki guda. Idan gangara 2 ce, daidai L ne, saboda haka bai dace ba.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Wannan amsa ce da aka rubuta a jimla tare da sharadi.
y-m-56-05.s.s2.because.model.2: Idan m=2, n=1, ya zama layi ɗaya da L, saboda haka suna haɗuwa a maki marasa iyaka. Suna haɗuwa a maki guda ne kawai idan gangara ba 2 ba ce.

y-m-56-06.goal: A bayanai inda ƙimomi biyu ke sauyawa tare, bambanta abin da za a iya faɗa tabbatacce da abin da ba za a iya ba, sannan bayyana da kalmomin da ƙane zai fahimta dalilin da ya sa bayanin kaɗai bai isa tabbatar da sanadi ba.
y-m-56-06.material:
Shagon kayan more rayuwa ya rubuta mafi girman zafin rana (digirin Celsius) da adadin ice cream da aka sayar cikin kwanaki takwas.

y-m-56-07.s.s1.r.a: Hukunci ne da ya ce idan maki sun karkata gefe guda, matsakaici da median na iya bambanta.
y-m-56-07.s.s1.o.b: Idan median 70 ne, matsakaici ba zai gaza 70 ba.
y-m-56-07.s.s1.r.b: Wannan tunani ne cewa matsakaici kullum ya fi ko daidai da median. Gwada yanayin ƙananan maki sosai.
y-m-56-07.s.s1.o.c: Idan median 70 ne, matsakaici ma dole ya kusa 70.
y-m-56-07.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tunani ne cewa ƙimar tsakiya da matsakaici kullum suna kama. Ka zana yanayin makin sun karkata gefe guda ƙwarai.
y-m-56-07.s.s1.o.d: Domin matsakaici ya yi ƙasa, dole ɗalibai biyar duk su gaza maki 70.
y-m-56-07.s.s1.r.d: Wannan tunani ne cewa kowa dole ya yi ƙasa don matsakaici ya yi ƙasa. Idan median 70 ne, duba cewa aƙalla ɗalibai uku sun sami 70 ko fiye.
y-m-56-07.s.s1.explain: Idan median 70 ne, c=70, d da e kuma aƙalla 70 ne. Idan a da b ƙanƙanta ne sosai (misali 0 da 30), jimilla ta yi ƙasa, matsakaici ma ya yi ƙasa. Saboda haka labarin zai yiwu.
y-m-56-07.s.s2.prompt: Nemo maki biyar a≤b≤c≤d≤e da suka cika sharudda duka, ƙirƙiri haɗuwa guda uku dabam-dabam. Sharudda: duk cikakkun lambobi ne daga 0 zuwa 100; median (c) maki 70 ne; matsakaici maki 62 ko ƙasa.
y-m-56-07.s.s2.hint.0: Saka 70 a matsayin c, da farko saka mafi ƙanƙantar ƙimomin da d da e za su iya ɗauka.
y-m-56-07.s.s2.hint.1: Lissafa yadda jimillar dole ta yi ƙanƙanta domin matsakaici ya zama 62 ko ƙasa, sannan ka yi tunani kan iyakar jimillar a da b.
y-m-56-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Dukkansu cikakkun lambobi ne daga 0 zuwa 100.
y-m-56-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Duk maki dole su zama cikakkun lambobi daga 0 zuwa 100.
y-m-56-07.s.s2.ok.c2: An jera su daga ƙaramin maki.
y-m-56-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Ba su cikin jerin a≤b≤c≤d≤e. Sake jera su daga mafi ƙanƙanta.
y-m-56-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Maki na tsakiya c ba 70 ba ne. Median ita ce ƙimar tsakiya bayan jera maki.
y-m-56-07.s.s2.fail.c4: Matsakaicin ya fi 62. Daidaita ƙananan makin ta yadda jimillar maki biyar idan an raba da 5 ta zama 62 ko ƙasa.
y-m-56-07.s.s2.explain: Tunda c=70, d,e≥70, d+e≥140. Domin jimilla ta zama 310 ko ƙasa (matsakaici 62 ko ƙasa), ana buƙatar a+b≤100 (ƙaramin d da e, ƙarin dama). y-m-56-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa matsakaici ya gaza median a haɗuwar da ka ƙirƙira; idan ka gabatar da wannan rukuni da lamba guda, shin za ka zaɓi matsakaici ko median, kuma me ya sa?
y-m-56-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Cire mafi ƙarancin maki daga haɗuwarka, sake lissafa matsakaici, ka kwatanta.
y-m-56-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ƙirga mutane nawa suka sami maki 70 ko fiye, ka yi tunani wace lamba ta fi dacewa da kalmar “wakilci”.
y-m-56-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa matsakaici ya ragu ta takamaiman maki (misali mafi ƙanƙanta)?
y-m-56-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka danganta dalilin zaɓar median da na zaɓar matsakaici da “abin da kake son gaya wa mutane”?
y-m-56-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ka yi tunani ko lamba guda da ka zaɓa za ta iya ba da hoton ƙarya game da rukuni?
y-m-56-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Ƙananan maki ɗaya ko biyu sun ja matsakaici ƙasa. Median tana duba matsayi na tsakiya kawai, don haka ta tsaya a 70. Lokacin gabatar da rukuni, mafi yawansu sun sami 70 ko fiye, don haka median 70 ya fi dacewa.
y-m-56-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Matsakaici yana haɗa duk maki ya raba, saboda haka ƙima ƙarama sosai kamar 0 tana shafar shi ƙwarai. Median ba ta jin wannan tasiri sosai; ya dace a bayar da matsakaici da median duka.
y-m-56-07.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Amsa ce da ta yi amfani da lambobin biyun maimakon zaɓar guda.

y-m-56-10.prereq.2: Wannan aikin yana nuna matakin wahala da tallafi H1 na rukuni da aka ƙirƙira ne kawai; ba ya nufin an sanya darasin a wani aji. Ana ɗauka an riga an koyi tushen ayyuka, geometry da bayanai na matakin sakandare.
y-m-56-10.title: Shin jadawalin kuɗin filin ajiye mota layi madaidaiciya ne?
y-m-56-10.topic: Jadawalin aiki: kuɗin da aka kayyade ga kowane tazara.
y-m-56-10.goal: Gwada alaƙar da kuɗi ke danganta da lokaci da ƙimomin tebur, ka ga cewa ra’ayin “yana ƙaruwa da adadi iri ɗaya a kowane minti” ba daidai ba ne, sannan ka bayyana sifar jadawalin da kalmomi tare da ƙirƙirar lokuta daban-daban masu kuɗi iri ɗaya.
y-m-56-10.material: Wannan ƙa’idar kuɗin filin ajiye mota ce ta ƙirƙira. Idan lokacin fakin minti 30 ko ƙasa da haka ne, kyauta ne. Idan ya wuce minti 30, ana biyan 500 won ga kowane minti 10 da ya wuce; ana ƙirga lokacin ƙasa da minti 10 a matsayin minti 10 (misali, minti 52 ya wuce da 22, don haka rukuni 3 ne kuma 1500 won). Kuɗin rana ba ya wuce 3000 won. Ka ɗauki lokaci a cikakkun mintuna kawai. Hyunwoo ya zana jadawalin kuɗi a matsayin “layi madaidaiciya da ya fara a (minti 30, 0 won) kuma ya ƙaru da 50 won a minti”.
y-m-56-10.thinking.0: Gwada ikirari (“layi madaidaiciya ne”) da ƙimomi takamaimai.
y-m-56-10.thinking.1: Samar da shigarwar daban-daban da ke da kuɗi iri ɗaya.
y-m-56-10.prereq.0: Tsara ƙimomin aiki a tebur (matakin sakandare).
y-m-56-10.prereq.1: Sanin cewa jadawalin daidaiton kai tsaye da ayyukan layi layuka madaidaiciya ne.
y-m-56-10.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk jimlolin da suka dace da ƙa’idar kuɗin.
y-m-56-10.s.s1.hint.0: Lissafta kuɗin minti 35, 36, 40 da 41 ɗaya bayan ɗaya bisa ƙa’idar, sannan ka rubuta su.
y-m-56-10.s.s1.hint.1: Gwada da minti 100 da 200 yadda iyakar kuɗin rana ke aiki yayin da lokaci ya ƙaru.
y-m-56-10.s.s1.o.a: A duk lokacin da lokacin fakin ya ƙaru da minti 1, kuɗin koyaushe yana ƙaruwa da 50 won.
y-m-56-10.s.s1.r.a: Wannan tunani ya raba matsakaici: 500 won ga minti 10 yana nufin 50 won a minti. Ka lissafta kuɗin minti 35 da 36 da kanka ka kwatanta.
y-m-56-10.s.s1.o.b: Kuɗin minti 35 da minti 40 iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-56-10.s.s1.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya yi amfani da ƙa’idar ƙidaya ta rukunin mintuna 10.
y-m-56-10.s.s1.o.c: Fakin minti 30 kyauta ne (0 won), saboda haka minti 31 ma kyauta ne (0 won).
y-m-56-10.s.s1.r.c: Wannan ra’ayi bai bincika iyakar kyauta ta minti 30 ko ƙasa da haka ba. Duba ko minti 31 ya wuce 30.
y-m-56-10.s.s1.o.d: Kuɗin fakin minti 100 da 200 iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-56-10.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya binciki shari’ar da iyakar kuɗin rana 3000 won ke aiki.
y-m-56-10.s.s1.explain: Minti 35 ya wuce da minti 5, minti 40 kuma ya wuce da 10; saboda haka duka rukuni 1 ne (500 won). Ga minti 100 da 200, lissafin ya wuce 3000 won, amma iyaka 3000 won ce, saboda haka duka 3000 won ne. Kuɗi ba ya ƙaruwa 50 won a kowane minti (35 da 36 duka 500 won ne), kuma minti 31 ya wuce 30, saboda haka 500 won ne.
y-m-56-10.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri lokutan fakin biyu daban t1<t2 (lambobi cikakku, minti) masu kuɗi iri ɗaya wanda ba 0 won ba. Nemo nau’i-nau’i uku masu kuɗi daban-daban (misali nau’i-nau’i ɗaya na 500 won, ɗaya kuma 1000 won). (Ka sa t2 bai wuce 240 ba.)
y-m-56-10.s.s2.hint.0: Yi amfani da ƙa’idar domin nemo mafi ƙarancin lokaci da mafi tsawon lokaci da kuɗinsu 500 won ne.
y-m-56-10.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi lokuta biyu a tsakanin waɗannan, sannan ka lissafta ko kuɗinsu iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-56-10.s.s2.ok.c1: Dukansu lambobi cikakku ne da suka wuce minti 30, kuma t1<t2.
y-m-56-10.s.s2.fail.c1: t1 dole ya wuce minti 30 (kuɗin ba 0 won ba ne), t1<t2, t2 kuma lamba cikakkiya ce da ba ta wuce 240 ba.
y-m-56-10.s.s2.ok.c2: Kuɗin lokutan biyun iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-56-10.s.s2.fail.c2: Kuɗin lokutan biyun sun bambanta. Duba ko suna cikin tazara ɗaya bisa ƙa’idar rukunin mintuna 10.
y-m-56-10.s.s2.explain: Kuɗi shi ne yawan rukuni, wato (lokacin da ya wuce ÷10) zagaye sama, ninka da 500 won (iyaka 3000 won). Lokuta biyu a rukuni ɗaya suna da kuɗi iri ɗaya: minti 31 zuwa 40 kuɗi 500 won; 41 zuwa 50, 1000 won; 51 zuwa 60, 1500 won; haka nan. Daga minti 81 zuwa sama duka 3000 won ne. Saboda haka akwai lokuta da yawa yadda ka ga dama masu kuɗi iri ɗaya.
y-m-56-10.s.s3.prompt: Yi amfani da takamaiman lokutan minti daga teburin kuɗi domin bayyana dalilin da ya sa jadawalin madaidaicin layin Hyunwoo ba daidai ba ne, sannan ka bayyana sifar jadawalin daidai da kalmomi.
y-m-56-10.s.s3.hint.0: Kwatanta kuɗin minti 35 da 36, sannan ka rubuta yadda suka bambanta da kuɗin da layin Hyunwoo ya bayar.
y-m-56-10.s.s3.hint.1: Idan za ka zana jadawalin, rubuta a matsayin zangon lokaci inda kuɗin ke ƙaruwa da inda yake nan yadda yake.
y-m-56-10.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Bayyaninka ya yi amfani da takamaiman lokutan minti da kuɗin won a matsayin misalai?
y-m-56-10.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta wuraren da kuɗi ke tashi kwatsam dabam da wuraren da yake nan yadda yake na ɗan lokaci?
y-m-56-10.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka kuma bayyana sifar bayan iyakar kuɗin rana 3000 won?
y-m-56-10.s.s3.model.0: Ba layi madaidaiciya ba ne. Ko minti 31 ne ko 40, kuɗinsu 500 won iri ɗaya ne; idan ya zama minti 41 sai ya yi tsalle nan take zuwa 1000 won, saboda haka siffar matakala ce. Bayan minti 80, ya zama 3000 won kuma ba ya sauyawa.
y-m-56-10.s.s3.model.1: Ana zagaye zuwa rukunin mintuna 10 sama; saboda haka ko lokaci ya ƙaru kaɗan, kuɗi yana tashi kwatsam, sannan ya tsaya yadda yake a mintuna 10 masu zuwa. Ba layi madaidaiciya ba ne da ke ƙaruwa 50 won a kowane minti bisa lokaci.
y-m-56-10.s.s3.modelNote.1: Wannan amsa tana bayyana sifar jadawalin da “yana tashi kwatsam sannan ya tsaya na ɗan lokaci”.
y-m-56-10.s.s3.model.2: A minti 35, layin Hyunwoo yana ba da 250 won, amma ƙa’idar tana ba da 500 won. A minti 36 ma 500 won ne, saboda haka yana tashi kamar matakala duk bayan mintuna 10.
